_doc: Flight model constants, read by scripts/sim/flight.gd. Units: mass in mass units, thrust in the thrust units of components.json (stats.thrust), positions in pixels, speed in px/s, angles in radians. Tile masses are not here: each tile in tiles.json has its own `mass` (unknown ids weigh 1.0). component_mass: whole-component mass by id; any component not listed weighs component_mass_per_cell times its footprint cells. cable_mass_per_cell: mass of one cable cell. linear_damping and angular_damping: exponential decay rates per second for velocity and spin. thrust_to_accel: acceleration (px/s^2) = throttle x thrust x thrust_to_accel / mass. turn_factor: angular acceleration (rad/s^2) = turn x thrust x turn_factor / mass. max_speed: speed cap in px/s.
